proof_body:
by
  intro ι _ s t x m₁ m₂ hs ht hd hm₁ hm₂
  have hn₁ : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
  have hn₂ : (t.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr ht)
  have hS₁ : ∑ i ∈ s, x i = s.card * m₁ := by
    rw [hm₁]
    field_simp
  have hS₂ : ∑ i ∈ t, x i = t.card * m₂ := by
    rw [hm₂]
    field_simp
  have hc : ((s ∪ t).card : ℝ) = s.card + t.card := by
    rw [Finset.card_union_eq_card_add_card.mpr hd]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_union hd, hS₁, hS₂, hc]
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) [DecidableEq ι] (s t : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (m₁ m₂ : ℝ), s.Nonempty → t.Nonempty → Disjoint s t → m₁ = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → m₂ = (∑ i ∈ t, x i) / t.card → (∑ i ∈ s ∪ t, x i) / (s ∪ t).card = (s.card * m₁ + t.card * m₂) / (s.card + t.card)
